name: reaction
effect: Can be activated in reaction to a specific event. Spend a Locked # when activating.

name: focus
effect: Lasts until you roll a 1 on a Dodge roll, the duration ends, you have 0 health, gain stacks of Stun, cast another Focus Spell, or drop the spell.

name: follower
effect: Followers take a turn immediately before or after you (your choice, unless they where created that turn). However, they will only ever roll 3d6. All of your Followers use these same 3 dice regardless of type.

name: side
effect: Can be used for dual weilding in the offhand.

name: versatile
effect: One-handed normally but gain +2 damage if Two-handed

name: throwable
effect: Throw the item within 6 tiles of you.

name: reaching x
effect: Melee attack at range of X.

name: loading x
effect: Can be used X of times before # must be used on it to reload

name: glow
effect: Can be used to activate 'Spell' Arts instead of an open hand, and you may spend # to illuminate up to 2 tiles around the item. (Lasts until you dispel it.)

name: on hit
effect: Applied if the target fails a Dodge roll.

name: bonus
effect: Is applied when giving an 7 or less for an Attack Sum.

name: downside
effect: Is applied when giving an 11 or higher for an Attack Sum.
